messages:
matt-devex: Heads up — ran into a parity issue between the Python and JS SDKs for errors during streaming responses. Python surfaces a typed StreamingError with retryable=true, JS just throws a generic Error and we lose the retry_hint.
anya: Ugh. Is this the partial-chunk failure we saw on the sample app?
sam: Yep. Repro steps: open stream, drop connection at ~3rd chunk, server returns a 499-ish internal stream abort. Python handler turned it into StreamingAbortError(retryable=true, hint='resume-from-offset'), JS returns 'NetworkError' only.
jess: That explains the onboarding support tickets — sample-app retries differently across SDKs so customers see different behavior.
leo: We should standardize on an error shape: {type, status, retryable, retry_after, hint, details_url}. SDKs translate to native exceptions but preserve those fields.
matt-devex: Proposal: add explicit StreamChunkError (non-fatal) and StreamConnectionError (fatal/retryable=false) types. Map server codes: 408/502/503 => retryable=true, 401/403 => retryable=false, 429 => RateLimit with retry_after.
anya: I can draft a minimal spec and examples for Python/JS/Go. Quick question — for streaming partial failures where we can resume, do we prefer retryable=true with hint 'resume' or a specialized resume token?
sam: Prefer resume token in hint if server provides it. Fallback to 'resume-from-offset' otherwise. Avoid opaque booleans alone.
jess: For onboarding docs, update sample-app to show 401 -> UnauthorizedError with clear user action (refresh tokens) and 429 -> RateLimitError(show retry_after). That should reduce support volume.
leo: Also add small test harness in sdk-integration-tests: simulate stream aborts and assert error.type + retryable. I can throw a PR for the harness.
matt-devex: Implementation plan: 1) spec draft (anya) 2) test harness (leo) 3) sample-app updates + docs (jess) 4) SDK patches (sam + others) 5) rollout and telemetry check to ensure we don't break existing consumers.
anya: Drafted spec snippet: ```json
{"type":"StreamingAbortError","status":499,"retryable":true,"hint":"resume-token:abc123","details_url":"https://redwood.dev/errors#streaming"}
```
sam: For JS, I'll expose a typed class RedwoodStreamingError with .retryable and .hint fields (not nested objects). For Python we keep exceptions but attach .error_info dict for parity.
jess: We should include minimal FAQ in onboarding: "Why did my SDK retry but not the other?" with examples.
leo: Who wants ownership of the SDK changes? I can lead Go and infra tests. Sam can do JS, Anya can coordinate Python.
matt-devex: Sounds good. Can we aim for a small beta by next week for the test harness and spec? If yes, I'll book a quick sync.
anya: I'll push the spec draft to the devex docs repo today.
ci-bot: CI started for branch \"stream-error-spec\" — 6 tests queued.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll start the JS patch after CI passes.
jess: I'll update the sample-app screenshots and add a troubleshooting section.
leo: I'll open the test PR in infra and link it here when ready.
matt-devex: thanks team — less noisy support in sight :tada:
